title: Plan Your Future
description: Architected a comprehensive development planner for CodeYourFuture graduates within an Agile team environment. Developed SMART goal tracking and progress visualization tools to streamline the transition from education to employment.

title: Blogify
description: Engineered a robust full-stack blogging platform featuring secure JWT authentication, rich text editing, and optimized image uploads. Focused on building a scalable architecture and seamless content management experience.

title: Collaboration Board
description: Developed a real-time collaborative whiteboard using WebSockets for instant bidirectional data synchronization. Captured canvas drawing events and broadcasted them across multiple client sessions for a seamless shared experience.

title: ChatApp
description: Implemented a real-time communication platform utilizing WebSockets to handle concurrent client-server connections. Designed the interface to update dynamically as messages are broadcast to all active users.

title: CodeWar Stars
description: Developed a dynamic leaderboard that consumes the Codewars API to visualize developer progress. Implemented real-time data fetching to display and compare user rankings effectively.

title: TV-Show Project
description: Designed a responsive media search interface that dynamically fetches and filters content from movie APIs. Focused on efficient DOM manipulation and a clean, user-centric browsing experience.
